critical.msg: GitHub token exposed in curl command-line arguments. The token is now passed via -H 'Authorization: Bearer {token}' inline instead of via PIPELINE_GH_TOKEN environment variable. Token will be visible in /proc/<pid>/cmdline and potentially shell history.

Lock acquisition lost atomicity guarantee. The os.O_EXCL atomic exclusive-create was replaced with simple path.exists() check followed by write_text. Two concurrent cron fires can both pass the exists() check before either writes, then both acquire the lock.

Token extraction regex changed from ([^@:]+) to ([^@]+). For URLs like https://x-access-token:TOKEN@github.com/..., the pattern now incorrectly captures 'x-access-token:TOKEN' as the token instead of just 'TOKEN'.

Bare except: clause silently swallows FileNotFoundError and JSONDecodeError in create_deploy_issue.py, replacing them with an empty dict. Critical errors are masked—no issue is created when artifact is missing or malformed, and the failure is invisible.

warnings: datetime.fromisoformat() no longer wraps result in .replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc). New code produces timezone-naive datetimes; datetime.now(timezone.utc) is timezone-aware. This can cause comparison RuntimeErrors in some Python versions/configurations.
The --force bypass for test-not-green in step_implement() was removed. This is a documented feature referenced in SOUL.md. Manual runs can no longer bypass the test gate.
step_research() now spreads **task AFTER canonical keys (task_id, created_at, source). The LLM-provided dict can now override these fields, contrary to the original Fix #7 intent.
suggestions: Consider restoring PIPELINE_GH_TOKEN environment variable approach for _gh_open_pr to avoid token exposure in process arguments.
Restore O_EXCL | O_CREAT atomic create in _Lock.__enter__ for race-condition-free lock acquisition.
Use except Exception instead of bare except to avoid catching SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt.
Add timezone awareness consistently: datetime.fromisoformat(data['generated_at'].rstrip('Z')).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) was correct before the change.
The implement agent was removed from the _collect_stats agent list (Fix #13 reverted). Restore 'implement' to the list if that agent should be tracked.
llm_parsed.summary: Four critical issues found. Security regression: GitHub token now exposed in curl command-line args (visible in /proc/cmdline) instead of via environment variable. Architecture regression: Lock acquisition lost atomic exclusive-create (O_EXCL), introducing race condition for concurrent cron fires. Token extraction regex changed to capture key-name prefix as part of token. Quality issue: bare except silently swallows FileNotFoundError/JSONDecodeError, masking critical failures. Warning: timezone-naive datetime comparisons may cause RuntimeError in strict environments.
